subject: Docs on the installed-tool model: WORKFLOW section 閘門, MEMORY, CODE-MAP, TODO section 0, HANDOFF T-list items 5 and 10 rewritten for actl; DECISIONS pointer left to main
objective: Design docs/design/project-runnable-entries.md (D-071) section 7 A-side Edit column (docs items), section 3 (ownership), section 4 (what the project declares), follow-up row 7. Entry name actl (D-072). The row '一個既有專案接上這一套' in the '哪些已經是程式' table (~300) -> 已實作: git clone A beside the project, actl doctor / migrate / hooks install, the tests section; pointer docs/TODO.md section 0. A5 untouched files: docs/DECISIONS.md byte-identical to the ticket base; 'git diff --stat <base>..HEAD' lists only docs/WORKFLOW.md docs/MEMORY.md docs/CODE-MAP.md docs/TODO.md docs/HANDOFF.md; the HANDOFF diff touches only lines inside the '#147 的 T 端配套清單' table.
test_plan: Worker, foreground: the A1-A3 greps as shell commands with output verbatim; timeout 590 python3 -m unittest tests.test_memory tests.test_rules_delivery tests.test_status tests.test_no_project_names; then tests.test_auto_fix alone (its T1 and ~4238/4701 cases read docs/WORKFLOW.md); 'git diff --stat <base>..HEAD' verbatim for A5. No new test file: docs-only ticket, assertions are the greps above. needs_verifier false: a verifier's case would re-run the same greps on the same five files (D-028 rename/small-edit class). Container runs as uid 0: no chmod-based unreadable-file cases (root reads them); use a missing file or invalid JSON instead. hard_block.patterns forbids the four process-signal spellings in added tests/** lines: never stop a child that way in a test; stop a served board only through the Popen handle as tests/test_board.py _stop does today; timeouts belong to subprocess.run(timeout=) inside scripts/.
